name: Soothsayers
overview: Scripture sternly warns against engaging with soothsayers, wizards, and those who seek familiar spirits, condemning such practices as defiling and abominable (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31; 20:6; Deuteronomy 18:9). The Lord commands His people not to learn or follow the occult customs of surrounding nations, emphasizing reliance on Him rather than astrologers or monthly prognosticators who claim to reveal hidden knowledge (Isaiah 47:13). God’s judgment against deceptive spiritual forces is assured, as He will punish the powers behind these false practices (Isaiah 27:1).
